items: P3.1 progress: packed C2 short-horizon graph retained

gates.full_suite_note: The preceding broad guard on the same base reached 82% with six failures then HIP-aborted in an unrelated P10 X2 layer test; that node passes isolated. Per focused-repair policy no broad rerun was made for this scoped change.
